descriptions.job-033srv7:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

"At TRM, we believe the people we hire will determine how far and how fast we can go in our mission to build a safer world for billions of people. That’s why we’re building a Talent team that sees recruiting as a craft and a competitive advantage, people who challenge assumptions, move with urgency, and are energized by building exceptional teams to solve incredibly hard problems. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you."

– Alicia Strait, VP of Talent, TRM Labs

The teams that keep TRM running — Strategic Finance, Legal, People, Operations — are what let us scale a mission-critical platform responsibly, at speed, in a heavily regulated space. As a Team Lead, G&A Recruiter, You’ll own TRM’s most strategic and mission-critical G&A searches while setting the standard for the G&A recruiting pod. You’ll manage your own requisitions, but your impact will extend across the team—driving consistency, raising the bar, and helping the pod operate as a tight, high-performing unit. As the day-to-day peer leader closest to the work, you’ll take meaningful operating overhead off the manager’s plate and help the team move with greater speed and precision.

Your success is measured by the quality, velocity, and business impact of hires across TRM's G&A organization as well as how successfully you mentor your teammates, and how well the pod around you performs.

How this role differs from a Senior or Staff G&A Recruiter: A Senior/Staff recruiter owns their searches exceptionally well. As Team Lead, you own your searches and the operating rhythm, unblocking, experimentation, and outcomes of the whole G&A pod. You’ll set the example for more junior recruiters on what exceptional partnership with executive stakeholders looks like.

The impact you'll have:

Leading the pod:

  • Run executive level G&A hiring syncs, driving the cadence, priorities, and follow-through for the team and its hiring managers.

  • Represent the G&A pod in headcount and workforce-planning discussions with Talent leadership, bringing the on-the-ground view from being closest to the department leads.

  • Bubble up what's happening across the G&A recruiting team — risks, wins, market signals, and blockers — so the manager and VP stay informed.

  • Drive solutioning and experimentation with the team, testing new sourcing angles, processes, and ideas and unblocking searches when they stall.

  • Help the team execute on retros and decision docs, turning what you learn into durable improvements.

  • Shape and roll out new processes and changes to the pod: when the team adopts a new way of working, much of it comes from you.

Owning your own searches:

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for senior and specialized G&A searches across Strategic Finance, Legal, People, Operations, and other corporate functions.

  • Act as a strategic talent partner to executive stakeholders; advising on market dynamics, candidate calibration, hiring strategy, and close approach.

  • Build and execute targeted sourcing strategies that identify, engage, and close exceptional G&A talent from high-growth technology, fintech, crypto, public sector, and financial services environments.

  • Develop deep market maps for priority searches that include competitive talent, high-performing corporate functions, and referral-driven networks.

  • Create an exceptional candidate experience for senior and specialized talent, so every touchpoint reflects TRM's talent bar, mission, and operating principles.

  • Use data, market insight, and funnel conversion metrics to diagnose search health, influence hiring teams, and adjust strategy in real time.

  • Serve as a craft leader on the Talent team, raising the bar for sourcing, stakeholder management, candidate engagement, and strategic search execution.

What we're looking for:

  • 10+ years of recruiting experience, with 7+ years of experience owning senior G&A searches in high-growth technology companies.

  • Experience leading or setting direction for a recruiting pod including running hiring syncs, unblocking other recruiters' searches, and driving team experimentation — whether or not you've formally managed people.

  • A track record of taking operating overhead off a manager's plate: owning team cadence, process rollouts, retros, and decision docs so the group runs as a tight unit.

  • Proven success hiring senior and specialized talent across Strategic Finance, Legal, People, Operations, and other corporate functions.

  • Strong search fundamentals including market mapping, talent intelligence, passive candidate engagement, confidential search management, and senior-level closing.

  • The ability to quickly understand complex corporate roles across finance, legal, compliance, people, operations, and business-critical leadership.

  • Strong analytical ability to interpret recruiting metrics, funnel health, conversion rates, and pipeline quality, and translate them into action for yourself and the team.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management, building trust, influencing senior leaders, pushing back thoughtfully, and operating as a strategic advisor throughout the process.

  • Excellent written and verbal executive presence, including synthesizing market insight, candidate tradeoffs, and search progress clearly for executive audiences.

  • High ownership, persistence, and judgment in navigating ambiguous, confidential, business-critical searches.

  • A demonstrated ability to balance speed with quality while holding a high talent bar for G&A hiring.

About the team:

  • Our talent team is fully remote and async-first. We keep work moving across time zones through Slack, thorough documentation, and proactive updates.

  • We stay tightly aligned through weekly hiring syncs, team sourcing syncs, and bi-weekly team meetings where we solve challenges together.

  • We care deeply about our craft: we continuously refine best practices and data quality to deliver an exceptional experience for candidates and internal stakeholders alike, backed by precise, reliable reporting.

  • We're globally distributed but most of us overlap between 7am–12pm PST for real-time collaboration.

  • Every team member, wherever they're based, maintains at least a 4-hour overlap with PST business hours.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within 72 hours of a role opening, you've scheduled the intake, researched and published the role, and brought 5 calibration profiles to the intake for the hiring manager to review.

  • Within a week of opening the role, you've mapped the total addressable market, built a shortlist of the top 30 profiles, conducted 5–10 recruiter screens, and stood up the full interview process — including the approved questions that define what good looks like on a recruiter screen.

  • Two weeks after the initial interviews, you analyze the data to identify what is and isn't driving pass rates and conversions, share insights and recommendations with the hiring team, and continue to monitor and adjust until the position is filled.

    Our Onboarding Process:

    • Within your first 30 days, you’ll be fully onboarded, calibrated, and operating as the DRI for your positions.

    • Within your first 60 days, you’ll have your first sourced candidates reaching final rounds.

    • Within your first 90 days, you’ll have made 2–3 hires.

The following represents the estimated range of compensation for this role:

  • Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $172,000 - $196,000.

  • Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

  • Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered.

What to Expect From Our Interview Process

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Typically 3–5 interviews to go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact.

  • Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions.

  • Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding.

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

Learn more about interviewing at TRM

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate

  • Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more about Interviewing at TRM

 

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. Learn more about building tools for defenders.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

descriptions.job-0ho16kz:
Consumer Marketing Lead

About Alpen

Alpen Labs builds infrastructure for financial markets on Bitcoin.

Alpen Finance, currently an internal project name, is our vision for a Bitcoin-native, neobank-like experience: a best-in-class way for users to hold and use BTC and stablecoins while accessing financial services such as credit, earning interest, and spending.

Alpen makes this possible directly on Bitcoin, giving users access to modern financial services without requiring them to trust centralized intermediaries. Alpen uses zero-knowledge technology and programmable Layer 2 infrastructure to achieve this.

Our team includes engineers and researchers from organizations such as Blockstream Research, zkSync, Palantir, and Nethermind, as well as contributors to major open-source cryptography and blockchain projects.

About the role

We are hiring a Consumer Marketing Lead to build the marketing function for Alpen Finance from the ground up.

The product is prelaunch, with no established acquisition playbook or proven channel mix. You will help determine who our first customers should be, which problems and use cases matter most to them, and how to bring the product to market.

This means developing and testing positioning, building qualified demand, and acquiring our first meaningful base of customers. It also means using customer conversations and early product behavior to influence what we build, how we launch, and where we focus next.

We’re looking for a hands-on marketer with meaningful consumer mobile-app experience, broad marketing fundamentals, and entrepreneurial product judgment. You will work closely with leadership, product, and engineering while personally driving strategy and execution—from early customer discovery through launch, adoption, and growth.

What you’ll do

Find the first customers and help shape product-market fit

  • Identify and test hypotheses about the customers, use cases, and problems where Alpen Finance can create the most value.

  • Use customer conversations, market research, and experiments to understand what would motivate people to try the product and keep using it.

  • Develop and test positioning, messaging, and the consumer value proposition.

  • Distinguish meaningful demand and product-market-fit signals from attention or low-intent signups.

  • Bring customer and market evidence into decisions about product priorities, launch markets, and go-to-market strategy.

Own go-to-market and launch

  • Build a practical marketing plan from prelaunch audience development through launch and early adoption.

  • Own the consumer-facing marketing for the product’s unveiling and launch, including campaigns, content, channel activity, and customer communications.

  • Build interest before the product is live while setting accurate expectations.

  • Establish the priorities, operating cadence, and marketing investment needed to execute.

Build acquisition and lifecycle programs

  • Find effective ways to reach prospective customers in a market where conventional paid advertising may be constrained.

  • Test channels such as content, community, referrals, partnerships, creators, events, and selective paid media.

  • Personally build and run campaigns, assets, and experiments, turning promising approaches into repeatable programs.

  • Shape the customer journey from awareness and waitlist participation through onboarding, activation, repeat use, and referral.

  • Evaluate growth through customer quality, behavior, retention, and economics.

Work closely with product and engineering

  • Connect the marketing promise with the product experience.

  • Understand where customers engage, convert, retain, or drop out, and use those findings to improve both marketing and the product.

  • Establish measurement and feedback loops that help the team decide what to test, change, or invest in next.

What we’re looking for

  • Relevant experience: 3+ years in marketing or growth, with meaningful ownership of go-to-market strategy, customer acquisition, and adoption.

  • Consumer mobile-app experience: You have directly marketed or grown a consumer mobile app and understand the journey from discovery and installation to activation and repeated use.

  • Zero-to-one experience: You have helped take a consumer product from prelaunch or an early stage through launch and meaningful adoption, building an approach before an established playbook existed.

  • Product and customer judgment: You can point to examples where customer research or behavior changed your target audience, positioning, use cases, or product priorities.

  • Broad marketing ownership: Your experience connects customer understanding, positioning, messaging, acquisition, and lifecycle marketing. You can work across these areas and decide what matters most at each stage.

  • Hands-on execution: You can turn strategy into campaigns, content, experiments, and day-to-day operating work.

  • Commercial judgment: You use activation, retention, referral, acquisition costs, and customer economics to make decisions about where to invest.

  • Cross-functional ownership: You work effectively with product, engineering, and leadership, and can move work forward with incomplete information.

Experience with consumer financial apps—particularly wallets, payments, neobanking, lending, cards, investing, or brokerage—is strongly preferred. We are especially interested in experience helping people adopt new financial behaviors through an app.

We care more about demonstrated work, ownership, and judgment than a particular title or career path.

Nice to have

  • Experience with consumer Bitcoin or crypto products.

  • Understanding of consumer behavior in U.S. and U.S.-adjacent markets, particularly how Bitcoin and fintech users think about trust, money, and adopting new financial apps.

  • Experience with community, creator, referral, partnership, content-led, or product-led acquisition.

  • Experience marketing products that require customers to understand risk and place meaningful trust in the product.

Why this role

  • Build from zero: Create the consumer marketing function and help shape the launch of a new financial app.

  • Meaningful ownership: Influence who we serve, how we position the product, and how we reach our first customers.

  • An open challenge: Discover what drives adoption for a product that does not fit neatly into conventional consumer-finance categories.

  • Technical ambition: Work alongside engineers and researchers building new infrastructure for Bitcoin-native finance.

  • Visible impact: Connect Alpen’s technology with useful financial experiences for consumers.

descriptions.job-11c8ij7:
At River, we are building the world's most trusted financial institution to empower people to take ownership of their financial lives through Bitcoin, the world's only incorruptible digital money. We believe in a future where every person will have bitcoin savings, and every business will have bitcoin on the balance sheet. We obsessively design and build delightful products that help our clients buy, sell, secure, and use Bitcoin.

We are looking for a Video Content Strategist to build River's YouTube channel and video output. You will own what we make and how we package it: sourcing and selecting ideas, writing host-led scripts, and crafting the titles and thumbnails that decide whether our work gets watched. Our audience is people who are navigating the reality that our money is slowly losing its value; your job is to make them trust us enough to hear the answers. The main goal of the channel is not to promote River’s products, it is to create valuable content you would enjoy watching.

You'll report to River's Director of Marketing and work closely with our Host-Producer, the marketing team, and company leadership.

River is growing quickly and has raised more than $50 million from leading investors, including Goldcrest, Kingsway, Polychain, M13, DG, and Valor. We have also released our company's financials publicly, so that all of our clients and employees can verify the robustness and growth of the business themselves.

What you will be doing:

  • Own the video content pipeline. Generate and filter video ideas, sourcing input from across the marketing team and our extensive research.

  • Own packaging of the titles and thumbnails. You'll craft them and test them.

  • Write scripts for medium to long form videos that make money and Bitcoin topics clear, engaging, and impossible to click away from. Some videos will be host-led, others animated.

  • Develop hooks and introductions to retain the audience and provide structure.

  • Ensure the story edit matches the script in structure and pacing.

  • Drive our success metrics on YouTube: view count, retention, and returning-viewer rate, and iterate relentlessly on what the data tells you.

  • Build the systems that let us produce quality content consistently: The idea backlog, filtering process, scripting process, and a testing loop for titles and thumbnails.

What we look for in you:

  • A track record of growing a video channel, your own or one you led. Not just script writing, but ideas and packaging that measurably moved views and retention.

  • An obsession with packaging. You study titles and thumbnails, you have real opinions about why videos win or lose, and you can prove your craft with examples.

  • Exceptional writing and storytelling. You can take a dense economic idea and make a stranger care about it in a single sentence.

  • A strong understanding of the YouTube algorithm, retention curves, and click-through rate.

  • You have a solid understanding of Bitcoin in the economic sense, and what makes it an answer to many of the financial problems the world faces.

  • A strong sense of ownership. You own the idea end to end, you gather input from the team, but the call is yours, and you stand behind the result.

  • You have integrity and know how to present the facts honestly and the brand professionally.

Nice to have:

  • On-camera, interviewing, or hosting experience.

  • A background in finance, economics, or journalism.

Salary and benefits:

  • Annual salary range of $110-165k depending on experience

  • Competitive compensation and equity

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off

  • Parental leave, separate from PTO policy

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance + 401k for US based employees

  • Remote option: You can work from anywhere in the Americas or Europe.

Interview process:

  • Screening interview with River's Director of Marketing (20 mins)

  • First round of interviews (1-hour block with River's Chief Product Officer and a Marketing teammate)

  • Take-home challenge (a paid packaging and scripting exercise)

  • Final round of executive interviews (1-hour block with River's COO and CEO)
descriptions.job-05u6gpf:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The role

We are looking for a Principal Designer to join the Cash App Banking team.

Banking is where Cash App becomes the place people actually keep their money. We design the core of that relationship: the Cash App Card, direct deposit, savings, Borrow, Cash App Green, Teens and Family accounts, physical Cash Tags, and bitcoin. These are the products customers touch every day and trust with the most consequential parts of their financial lives.

This is a hands-on principal role for a designer who sets the bar rather than describes it. You will own ambiguous, highest-stakes work: taking zero-to-one product ideas from a rough thesis to a shipped experience, and raising the craft standard on everything already in market. You will work across the whole surface, from the systems logic underneath a product to the last five percent of polish that makes it feel inevitable.

Banking design work is unusually constrained. Real money moves, regulation is real, and trust is the product. We are looking for someone who treats those constraints as the interesting part, and who can make something clear, warm, and distinctive inside them.

We are someone who is fluent with AI and prototyping tools and uses them to explore more, decide faster, and put working software in front of people early, without ever trading away craft.

You Will

  • Drive zero-to-one product experiences that are both strategically sharp and visually distinctive
  • Set and hold the quality bar for Banking design, defining what excellent looks like and demonstrating it in your own work

  • Prototype early and often, using AI and emerging tools to compress the distance between an idea and something people can actually use

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. About Fasset

At Fasset, we believe your money should answer to you. We are a banking and investment platform built around a simple idea: more people should have access to the financial system, regardless of where they live. We are building the global financial system for ownership, one that moves what you earn into what you own, so that what you can own is never decided by where you were born.

We operate across emerging markets, with a particular focus on the Middle East, Asia and Africa. Founded by Mohammad Raafi Hossain and Daniel Ahmed, Fasset has raised more than $80 million and holds regulatory approvals across markets including the UAE, Indonesia, Malaysia, the EU, Türkiye and Pakistan.

We are a fast-moving, global team scaling a regulated platform across multiple markets. Our culture runs on HEART: Humble Curiosity, Enthusiasm, Act Like Owners, Raise the Bar, and Tenacity. And we hold one simple view about the people who join us: the owners arrive early.

About the role

Seven events in six countries, five different growth workstreams, and several open roles to fill, all with hard deadlines through December. This role exists to make sure all of it actually happens on time: venues get booked, vendors get paid, decisions get made and followed through, and nothing falls through the cracks. You'll have real ownership day to day — picking vendors, planning travel, running the recurring team meetings — while bigger calls (big spend, signing contracts, anything public-facing) go through your manager for approval. It's a hands-on, high-trust role: by the end of the year you'll have delivered a full slate of international events and built the systems that keep a fast-moving growth team organized, with a clear path afterward into a bigger role in events, growth, or operations.

What you'll do

  • Run the operating cadence — weekly growth and studio reviews, a monthly scorecard, and per-stop go/no-go calls. Circulate written inputs the day before, log decisions and owners after, and chase follow-through while there's still time to fix it.
  • Own Buildathon production end to end — seven stops from September to December, covering venue, vendors, permits, budget, run of show, guest list, travel, on-site delivery, and close-out.
  • Manage vendors and suppliers — sourcing, negotiating, contracting, paying on time, and holding them to spec across venues, AV, production, research, and the freelance creative bench.
  • Maintain programme tracking — one place where every commitment across the five streams lives with an owner and a date, and you're accountable for the tracker being true.
  • Provide executive enablement — roughly one day a week of calendar and inbox triage, travel, briefing packs before every meeting that matters, and holding threads that would otherwise drop.
  • Keep hiring operations moving — scheduling, candidate experience, and no candidate waiting a week for a reply.

What you'll bring

Must have

  • Has produced live events end to end, in more than one country. You booked the venue, argued with the AV supplier, and fixed the thing that broke ninety minutes before doors. This is the requirement we will probe hardest in interview.
  • Travel ready. Roughly five to six weeks in transit between September and December across the UAE, Turkey, Pakistan, Japan, the UK and the US. You need existing visa-free access or valid multi-entry visas for those markets, or the ability to obtain them without a process that would delay a booking. Trips are sometimes confirmed at two weeks' notice.
  • Works well when it is messy. You can take a half-formed instruction and come back with a plan. You can hold a dozen open threads in your head while you build the system that will hold them. Very little here arrives fully specified.
  • About the admin. Roughly a day a week of this job is calendar, inbox, travel and expenses. That share is capped and it is permanent. People who do well here accept it as the price of having their hands on everything else. If reading that gives you pause, say so at first interview.
  • Also wanted. Writes clearly and briefly. Can chase senior people and keep the relationship. Reads a budget and spots the line that is wrong. Has worked closely with a founder or a leadership team.

Nice to have

  • Experience working in fast-paced fintech, technology, or other high-growth environments.
  • Experience coordinating international events, conferences, activations, or community programmes across multiple markets.
  • Comfortable with project management and collaboration tools.
  • Strong commercial instincts – able to negotiate with vendors, manage budgets, and make sensible trade-offs.

Not a 100% match? We'd still love to hear from you. We hire for potential and HEART, not a checklist, so apply if the mission excites you.

What we offer

  • Ownership from day one. High-trust, high-ownership culture where you get room to act like an owner and the support to raise the bar.
  • Competitive pay, benchmarked across our markets and reviewed as you grow.
  • A real path forward through Grow with Fasset (#GwF), our L1–L7 progression framework with both IC and Manager tracks.
  • Global exposure working alongside a team spread across seven markets, solving problems that matter for emerging economies.
  • Learning and development support to keep growing your craft.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

This is a new logo acquisition role focused on hunting, closing, and activating large, global Enterprise customers. You’ll play a key role in shaping Ramp’s up-market strategy, partnering cross-functionally to help modernize how the world’s largest organizations manage spend.

  • Demonstrated success selling complex software; Fintech experience is a plus

  • Strong technical fluency — able to demo, discuss integrations, and map workflows with technical and finance stakeholders

Do you want to be at the forefront of combating crypto-enabled sanctions evasion? Are you excited about leading the intelligence research that helps financial institutions and governments disrupt illicit financial networks? Are you looking for a values-led company that trusts you to own your domain and make a real impact?

The impact you will have:

Join Elliptic's Intelligence team as the go-to subject matter expert (SME) on cryptoasset sanctions. Sitting at Senior level, you will own Elliptic's end-to-end coverage of sanctioned entities, jurisdictions, and evasion typologies, and translate that expertise into high-quality analytical outputs, scalable monitoring processes, and clear internal and external communications.

Your work will directly strengthen the intelligence dataset that underpins our products, helping hundreds of financial institutions, exchanges, and government agencies take defensible sanctions-compliance decisions every day.

You will coach and collaborate with colleagues across the Intelligence function, contribute to cross-functional initiatives with Product, Engineering, and Customer teams, and represent Elliptic's capabilities to clients, regulators, and industry partners.

What you will do:

  • Serve as the go-to SME on global sanctions regimes, applying your expertise independently to resolve complex analytical questions and produce reliable outputs without requiring senior oversight on domain-level judgements.

  • Own and document a comprehensive coverage framework for global sanctions designation regimes.

  • Lead end-to-end investigations into cryptoasset exposure to sanctioned entities, state-linked actors, high-risk jurisdictions, and evasion networks, owning the full project lifecycle from scoping through to final output.

  • Define and drive the evolution of Elliptic's sanctions monitoring operating model.

  • Proactively identify and remediate coverage gaps across regimes and designating authorities.

  • Coach and mentor more junior colleagues within the Intelligence function, sharing domain knowledge and contributing to a consistently high standard of analytical practice.

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer teams to translate sanctions intelligence into platform capabilities.

  • Produce written intelligence outputs including reports, briefings, blogs, whitepapers, and client-facing content.

  • Represent Elliptic's sanctions intelligence at industry events, client briefings, and regulatory engagements.

What you will achieve in the first 6 months:

  • Have a thorough understanding of Elliptic's monitoring approach, our coverage framework, monitoring cadence and source-of-truth references.

  • Contribute to external-facing research output on sanctioned entities or emerging threats, such as a blog post, research report, or client briefing.

You will be a great fit here if:

  • You are the kind of person others turn to for sanctions expertise and can own domain-level judgements end-to-end, independently.

  • You proactively close knowledge and coverage gaps rather than escalating them, and treat systemic risks as personal accountabilities.

  • You are comfortable translating deep domain expertise into scalable processes, automation requirements, and clear written outputs for diverse audiences.

  • You communicate complex sanctions topics with precision and clarity, adapting your approach for technical and non-technical stakeholders inside and outside Elliptic.

  • You enjoy working collaboratively across functions and contribute readily to product, engineering, and customer conversations grounded in your domain knowledge.

  • You take initiative on emerging topics and cross-functional projects rather than waiting to be directed.

  • You are curious about how sanctioned actors and networks exploit the cryptocurrency ecosystem.

Our ideal candidate has:

  • Significant professional experience as an intelligence analyst, investigator, or compliance specialist in sanctions compliance, financial crime, law enforcement, or the crypto industry.

  • Demonstrated, independent subject matter expertise in global sanctions regimes, including practical knowledge of OFAC, UK, EU, and UN frameworks and the operational distinctions between autonomous designating authorities and supranational regimes.

  • Experience designing or improving monitoring and alerting frameworks, triage processes, or investigation playbooks in a compliance or intelligence context.

  • Proven ability to identify systemic coverage risks and drive durable remediation, including process improvement and automation planning.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of producing high-quality, stakeholder-ready outputs independently and to deadline.

  • Proficiency with blockchain analytics tools, open-source intelligence (OSINT), corporate registries, and adverse media sources.

  • AI fluency is essential for this role. You must be able to demonstrate your ability to effectively apply AI tools and approaches relevant to intelligence analysis, including using AI to accelerate research workflows, pattern identification, OSINT processing, and the drafting of written outputs.

Bonus Points for:

  • Direct experience with researching sanctions evasion typologies involving state-linked actors, procurement networks, critical technology supply chains, or high-risk financial intermediaries.

  • Experience with automated sanctions list monitoring, cross-referencing tooling, or detection logic design.

  • Technical understanding of cryptoassets, blockchain architecture, and on-chain analytics methodologies.

Benefits


> How we work:

  • Hybrid working: The option to work from almost anywhere for up to 90 days per year.

  • Remote Work Budget: $650 budget to set up your home office space.

> Learning & Development:

  • L&D Budget: $1,000 annual Learning & Development budget to use on anything (agreed with your manager) that contributes to your growth and development.

> Vacation / Leave:

  • Holidays: 25 days of annual leave + 8 US Public Holidays.

  • Birthday Leave: An extra day off for your birthday.

  • Enhanced Parental Leave: We provide eligible employees, regardless of gender or whether they become a parent by birth or adoption, 16 weeks fully-paid leave.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

The team is responsible for building a cohesive developer-first API and is tasked with planning, ideating, experimenting, and putting into production the new services, and libraries that overcome some of our greatest technical challenges as we continue to scale rapidly.

About Us

Socket helps devs and security teams ship faster by cutting out security busywork. Thousands of orgs use Socket to safely find, audit, and manage open source code. Our customers - from Anthropic to xAI, and Figma to Vercel - love Socket (just check out their tweets to see for yourself!)


Founded by Feross Aboukhadijeh, a long-time open source maintainer with software downloaded over a billion times a month, Socket has raised $125M in funding from top angels, operators, and security leaders.

Socket is hiring a Social Media Manager to own our presence across every platform where developers and security practitioners are paying attention. We want someone who runs our channels like a product: watching metrics and trends closely, and changing course fast when something isn't landing.

The role requires solid video and audio editing skill and narrative discipline. We build stories across weeks and campaigns, not single disconnected posts. It requires exceptional command of meme culture and internet humor, applied correctly and distinctly across each platform we operate on. And it requires being AI native: using modern AI tools by default to amplify your own creativity and push the boundaries of what technical content can look like. A portfolio showcasing your content, editing, and storytelling work is required as part of your application.

Experience in DevRel, technical marketing, or a technical newsroom is a bonus. Prior full ownership of a content calendar, solo, is also a bonus.

What You'll Do

Own the Platforms

  • Manage Socket's presence across every platform in our mix, and help identify where we should expand next

  • Track performance metrics and platform trends on an ongoing basis, and adapt content and strategy based on what the data shows

  • Keep Socket present and timely in fast-moving developer conversations and trends as they happen

Produce the Content

  • Slice long-form podcasts, webinars, and interviews into high-impact 30 to 60 second clips

  • Edit and optimize clips for each platform with captions, dynamic cuts, and visual hooks

  • Turn technical blog posts and product updates into carousels, memes, and short screen-recording walkthroughs

  • Run a consistent, reliable weekly content calendar

Engage the Community

  • Engage directly in comments, reply to industry peers, and jump into trending tech topics with Socket's point of view

  • Build a recognizable presence in developer conversations, not just a posting schedule

  • Inbound inbox triage, and crisis and reputation monitoring

 

About You:

  • Deep tech and developer literacy: fluent in developer culture, humor, tools, and pain points

  • Exquisite meme capabilities, applied judiciously across different platforms and tones

  • Terminally online, sharp, and technically precise

  • AI native: uses modern AI tools by default as part of how the work gets done

  • Proven short-form video and audio editing skills, backed by a strong portfolio

  • Demonstrated storytelling ability across a series of posts or a campaign, not just single posts

  • Platform fluency: a distinct voice and editing approach for each platform we operate on

  • A deep sense of ownership over the channels and the content, not just execution of a calendar

  • Ability to take a rough idea or concept and move fast, without needing every detail specified

  • Impeccable discretion regarding online communication, given the visibility and stakes of a public brand voice

  • Experience in DevRel, developer marketing, or a technical newsroom or media environment, preferred

  • Existing presence or credibility within a developer community, preferred

  • Experience owning a content calendar solo, end to end

  • Comfort with security, infrastructure, and open source subject matter

Hiring is a big decision on both sides. Read more about our Hiring Philosophy and how we approach the process at Socket.

Benefits: Our benefits are crafted to support you and your family, so you can take care of what matters most and thrive in and outside of work. We offer:

  • Market competitive salary bands

  • Meaningful equity program

  • Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family (99% coverage)

  • Flexible time-off, holidays, and winter shutdown to rest & recharge

  • Paid parental leave

  • Remote-first, with quarterly team off-sites

At Socket, we

  1. Pursue Excellence: We set ourselves apart by consistently delivering work of exceptional quality and distinction.

  2. Move with urgency and focus: We prioritize swift, decisive action.

  3. Think rigorously: We care about being right and it often takes reasoning from first principles to get there. We value alternative perspectives and have constructive discussions.

  4. Trust and amplify: We overtrust, always assume good intent, and give specific feedback to help each other improve.

  5. Feel a strong sense of ownership: We wear many hats and feel a strong sense of overall ownership of the company and we're non-territorial regarding our nominal domains.

  6. Are customer obsessed: We relentlessly prioritize the needs of our customers, striving to exceed their expectations and delight them at every interaction.
descriptions.job-1tyvxar:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The Financial Operations team’s mission is to provide accurate, complete, and timely financial and operational information to our leaders, regulators, customers, and key stakeholders. We ensure efficient asset utilization, proactively mitigate risks, and ensure full compliance with regulatory bodies.

We are seeking a Financial Operations Manager to join our growing team on the ground in Singapore. In this role, you will lead our local financial regulatory reporting and finops work, ensuring adherence to Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) regulations while collaborating across international entities. As one of the early operational hires in Singapore, you will play a key role in building processes from the ground up with high autonomy and visibility.

This role is based in our Singapore office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. 

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Manage risk for back-office activities by maintaining controls over customer and firm cash, suspense accounts, and exception handling. Execute daily trust and custody computations by the strict deadline of 12:00 PM SGT in compliance with Securities and Futures (Licensing and Conduct of Business) Regulations (SF(LCB)R).
  • Manage automated MT940 (Swift) messages and API pulls, extract customer ledger balances, and download statements from trust banks and sub-custodians. Reconcile security quantities against sub-custodian statements and verify no liens or encumbrances are placed on customer assets.
  • Monitor Financial Resources to ensure continuous compliance above Total Risk Requirement (TRR) limits. Prepare and submit quarterly filings via the MAS-Tx portal, including Form 1 (Statement of Assets & Liabilities), Form 2 (Statement of Financial Resources & TRR), and Form 7 (Aggregate Margin Exposure).
  • Partner closely with Corporate Accounting, Treasury, RHS Clearing, and Engineering teams to support system transitions (e.g., system migrations, report automation) and cross-train across broader global entity reporting.

What you bring

  • Deep understanding of MAS Risk-Based Capital (RBC) frameworks, SF(LCB)R requirements, and capital requirements for broker-dealers in Singapore.
  • 5+ years of experience in financial operations or regulatory reporting within a broker-dealer or financial institution in Singapore.
  • Experience managing back-office ledger systems, Swift/API data feeds, and reporting automation using tools like Excel/Google Sheets (SQL or data visualization tools like Superset are a plus).
  • Strong self-starter attitude with proven success operating independently in a fast-paced environment and managing time-sensitive regulatory deadlines (e.g., 12:00 PM SGT daily deliverables).
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to partner with global teams across varying time zones.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership
  • Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. 
  • Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs

Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity.

If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.

Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.
descriptions.job-0gxla1f:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Global Partner Engineering and Operations (PE&O) team is a vital part of Stripe’s Global Partnerships organization, playing a key role in our overall success. We manage the technical and operational dimensions of new and existing strategic product partnerships and programs. Positioned at the nexus of product development, engineering, and partnerships, we facilitate seamless collaboration essential for supporting Stripe’s rapid growth.


Our team is a diverse mix of technical and business professionals dedicated to executing operations with financial ecosystem partners. We ensure efficient technical onboarding and implementation, while also overseeing ongoing KTLO (Keep-The-Lights-On) activities and achieving strict quality and performance benchmarks. Additionally, the PE&O team initiates partner-agnostic programs and solutions to tackle broad ecosystem challenges, developing tools that enhance operational efficiency and scalability.

In This Role

The team is establishing a new function to oversee Card Network Compliance. In this position, you will be responsible for developing programs and processes to address Stripe’s card network changes and their implications for both Stripe and its users. This role is crucial for ensuring we stay informed about ongoing card network announcements, enhancing our strategic position, and driving operational efficiency in response to changes.

 

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute significantly to building a function from the ground up and to help formulate strategies that align with the best interests of Stripe and its users!

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Implement Release Management Process: Establish a release management process for Stripe in accordance with Card Network mandates, advising all cross-functional partners on the impacts, changes, and timelines associated with network updates. Conduct comprehensive analyses of how these mandates affect existing processes and services.
  • Review Card Network Releases: Review, analyze, and assess biannual card network releases to identify key initiatives that will significantly impact Stripe’s business. Collaborate cross-functionally with various teams to ensure proper visibility and prioritization of these initiatives. Facilitate communication between engineering teams and the card networks' Technical Partner Managers (TPaMs) to streamline clarifications and negotiations regarding complex mandates and programs.
  • Monitor Compliance: Establish a framework and process for monitoring compliance with card network requirements and internal policies. Ensure regular audits and assessments are conducted to identify gaps and drive continuous improvement strategies.
  • Develop Metrics and Dashboards: Create and implement comprehensive metrics and JIRA dashboards to effectively monitor, review, and analyze mandates for each release cycle. Regularly update and refine the dashboards to reflect current business priorities and challenges, enabling teams to make informed decisions and proactively address potential issues related to card network mandates.
  • Manage Mandate Intake Process: Oversee the network mandate intake process, ensuring timely review, assessment, and prioritization of mandates. Lead the proactive management of waiver requests, liaising between compliance and operational teams for resolution.
  • Engage with External Partners: Actively engage with external network partners by participating in councils, forums, and regular strategic meetings. Establish and nurture relationships that facilitate mutual understanding of goals and objectives.
  • Advocate for Stripe: Serve as a dedicated advocate for Stripe within the card network ecosystem, ensuring that the unique perspectives, challenges, and opportunities faced by Stripe are considered by network stakeholders.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in the payments industry, with significant expertise in working with card networks and understanding card network rules and compliance activities.
  • In-depth understanding of acquiring platforms and systems, and their interactions with card network products and processes.
  • Proficient in navigating and using JIRA for project management and tracking. Familiarity with card network portals for managing and monitoring compliance activities. Comfortable utilizing Google Workspace tools (such as Sheets, Docs, and Slides) for collaboration and documentation.
  • Proven track record of effectively collaborating with product and engineering teams to develop new processes and strategies in partnership with them.
  • Strong program and project management abilities, with the capacity to engage and influence stakeholders outside of direct control.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively engage with both internal and external partners and drive change.
  • Ability to thrive with minimal guidance, navigating uncertainty and ambiguity while shaping a new program and function at Stripe.
  • Strategic thinker adept at identifying cross-functional issues, providing innovative solutions, and communicating the implications of these solutions across existing processes, systems, and teams.

Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience at a payment service provider (PSP), card network, or high-growth technology company  is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Finance, Technology) is preferred.
descriptions.job-1x2hcnn:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
 
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a dedicated and proactive VIP Relationship Manager to join our Australian Strategic Markets team.

As a VIP Relationship Manager, you will play a key role in expanding our base of VIP clients in Australia. This role is focused on high net worth individuals, family offices and smaller corporate clients, driving our growth through partnerships and key client development in parallel to our institutional team, which on the other hand focuses on larger professional, enterprise and institutional clients.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Primary goal: maximize revenue in the region through onboarding and retention of VIP clients
  • Formulate an AUM strategy and revenue optimization based on the product offering of OKX in Australia
  • Work closely with the local executive leadership team to contribute to the overall strategic direction of the company
  • Lead our partnership work in Australia through identifying the right partners to work with plus executing any partnership negotiations

  • Build long lasting client relationships to obtain referrals and new sales channels - origination of new prospective clients
  • Proactive account management, work with operations to inform clients of potential roadblocks - frozen accounts, EDD etc.
